'''Gree''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]], a small region in the [[Veragi sector/Legends|Veragi sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] [[Species/Legends|species]], a race of six-[[Limb/Legends|tentacled]] [[Cephalopod/Legends|cephalopods]] who, despite having an advanced form of [[Gree technology|technology]], allowed their society to fall into ruin when they began prizing an individual's mastery of their advanced devices over improving them or creating new ones. As the [[Operator]] caste became more powerful within Gree society, they guarded the secrets of operating and manipulating their devices, sometimes [[Death/Legends|dying]] before they could pass the knowledge on to their apprentices.

Gree served as the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the Enclave and was considered to be the cultural center of Gree society, revered by all members of the species as a sacred place. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Gree had fallen into ruin following the near-collapse of Gree society. Only one major [[Capital city (Gree)|city]] remained, and the rest of the planet was a virtual wasteland covered in barren plains and abandoned ruins. Little was known of the planet to other species; the Gree restricted visitors to the world, with individuals only being permitted onto the world at the behest of the planetary [[grand council]].

==Description==
The [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;an ancient race of six-tentacled [[Cephalopod/Legends|cephalopods]]&mdash;Gree was located within<ref name="TGE" /> the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] [[Gree system/Legends|of the same name]],<ref name="TEA-OC" /> which lay deep in the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]],<ref name="TGE" /> a small region of space in the [[Veragi sector/Legends|Veragi sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA-OC" /> The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was accessible by [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] routes from the worlds of [[Malanose]] and [[Lonatro]], and was the only world within the Enclave that had a direct route to [[Licha In]]. The distance between Gree and these worlds could be traversed by the [[Rokak'k Baran]]&mdash;a large Gree-designed [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] with a Class 3 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]&mdash;in two [[Standard day/Legends|days]]. Gree had a Type II [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]],<ref name="TGE" /> which meant that life could be sustained on the planet, but due to environmental factors&mdash;such as higher or lower atmospheric pressure, ratio of [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] to other gases, or contaminants in the air&mdash;it was suggested that [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]] were worn by species that had evolved in a Type I atmosphere to counter any negative effects they might suffer.<ref name="pog1">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One]]''</ref> It was, however, comfortable for the native Gree. A standard day on the planet was twenty-seven [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] long, and a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] lasted 360 local days.<ref name="TGE" />

Following the near-collapse of Gree society, the planet was a barren and harsh world by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]; the surface was predominately wasteland, and covered in the ruins of abandoned [[City/Legends|cities]]. Only one [[Capital city (Gree)|city]] remained habitable, and it was home to 60 million Gree during the years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The planet was ruled by a [[grand council]], and was also the location of the [[grandmaster council]], the [[Politics/Legends|political]] body that all planetary grand councils answered to.<ref name="TGE" />

Gree was also the destination point of at least two [[hypergate]]s&mdash;devices capable of instantaneous transport of people and objects between two points&mdash;based on Asation. Although non-functional by the time of the Galactic Civil War, travel between the two worlds had been common before the decline of Gree civilization.<ref name="TGE" />

==History==
[[File:Gree_Enclave.jpg|thumb|left|A map of the Gree Enclave]]
Gree society reached its apex<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> more than [[30,000 BBY|30,000 years]] before the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="Dating">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' notes that the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] arose after the Gree reached the apex of their society. ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' states that the Infinite Empire was dominant in the galaxy between [[30,000 BBY]] and [[25,200 BBY]], meaning the Gree were at their height before this time.</ref> The planet Gree was held in high regard by the Gree, who&mdash;regardless of whether or not they had visited the planet&mdash;considered it a sacred and revered place. As the home planet of their civilization, it was at the center of Gree culture. Non-Gree visitors to the planet were extremely rare, and had to be specially invited by the planet's grand council. This usually occurred when conducting large-scale business with off-worlders on [[Asation]]&mdash;the gateway world to the Gree Enclave&mdash;was undesirable or unacceptable to the Gree themselves.<ref name="TGE" /> Some time before [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="PO">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Gree: Power Outage|Coruscant}} &ndash; the presence of a Gree delegation on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at this time means first contact with between the Galactic Republic and the Gree must have occurred before this date.</ref> the Gree Enclave was discovered by a [[Scout/Legends|scout]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Marrix]], leading to first contact between the Gree and the Galactic Republic. Marrix was respected by the Gree, and was allowed to visit their homeworld on a single occasion.<ref name="TGE" />

By the time of the Galactic Civil War, the history of Gree, and its native species, was a mystery, even to the Gree themselves. Scholars believed that the Gree species evolved on Gree thousands of years before the Galactic Civil War, and their civilization had slid into ruin before the formation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was rumored that the [[Unidentified Consul-General|predecessor]] to Imperial [[Consul-General]] [[Skalus]] was permitted to visit the planet when he negotiated the [[Annexation of Asation|annexation]] of Asation into the Empire. Those visitors who were permitted onto the planet conducted scholarly, diplomatic, or trade negotiations.<ref name="TGE" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|Gree (species)/Legends}}
[[File:Gree-AlienEncounters.png|thumb|right|180px|A Gree]]
The planet was inhabited by the Gree, and was the species' homeworld. Non-Gree were not allowed to immigrate to the planet, and off-world visitors were a rarity. The Gree were one of the oldest races that evolved in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], mastering [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] flight before many species had even entered their industrial ages. During this time, they developed a unique [[Gree technology|form of technology]] based around the process of [[material synthesis]]. Devices constructed by the Gree were individually unique, and emitted [[Music/Legends|musical]] notes as they were activated&mdash;in effect, requiring the operator to "play" the device. Each device was attuned to Gree physiology, requiring the use of six tentacles to operate properly. The technology became the cornerstone of Gree society, and was employed throughout the Enclave.<ref name="TGE" />

Originally, the Gree employed a caste system consisting of four professions: the [[Crafter]]s who produced new devices; the [[Researcher]]s who designed new devices; the [[Operator]]s who manipulated and used the devices; and the [[Administrator (caste)|Administrators]] who acted as the Gree government. Over time, however, the Gree began focusing on the artistry of actually operating the devices rather than attempting to improve them, or create new ones. As the Gree decided that their technology had reached its apex, the Crafter and Researcher castes, no longer deemed necessary to society, died out. The Operators became more influential in Gree society, with more and more power ceded to them by the Administrators. As [[Master (Gree)|masters]]&mdash;those Gree capable of activating and maintaining the Gree devices&mdash;died without passing on their expertise, the knowledge to operate many devices was lost. Without the Crafter and Researcher castes, the Gree gradually lost the ability to create and repair their technology as devices failed. By the time of the Galactic Empire, the Gree civilization was a shadow of its former self; although they had access to advanced technological devices, they had no idea how to improve upon them or repair them. Maintenance of the existing devices were of paramount importance to the Gree, and masters from the Operator caste dominated Gree culture and society due to their ability to operate the remaining devices.<ref name="TGE" />

==Locations==
The Gree [[Capital/Legends|capital]] was the only inhabited city on the planet during the time of the Empire. Situated on a large plain, the city was a sprawling affair, made up mainly of halls and skyscrapers. Although home to 60 million Gree, much of the city was abandoned, and it had no [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] of any kind. Incoming ships were required to land on a flat slab in the center of the city. Advanced Gree technology was common in the city; in some cases surpassing the technological level that was standard on Imperial worlds at the time. However, anachronistic technology that was well under the Imperial standard was also in evidence.<ref name="TGE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Gree was first introduced in ''[[The Gree Enclave]]'', an article published in [[West End Games]]' [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 8|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 8]], in [[November]] [[1995]]. It was written by [[Timothy S. O'Brien|Timothy O'Brien]]. The information was subsequently reprinted in ''[[Classic Adventures: Volume Four — The Best of the Journal]]'', released in [[1997]], and mention was made of the planet in the Gree entry in ''[[Alien Encounters]]''.
